dedupe_keys.name: hybrid energy system techno economics for 634 philippine islands

description: This dataset describes hybrid renewable-energy options for 634 off-grid Philippine islands grouped into 616 microgrids. The producer reports locations, demand, renewable-resource potential, optimized component sizes and financial indicators for systems combining photovoltaic panels, wind turbines, batteries and diesel generators. Results include five electricity-price scenarios. Mendeley’s public inventory lists an Excel workbook, freely available under CC BY 4.0. The coverage is national island planning cases, with synthetic hourly demand and monthly average resource inputs; it is not a continuous operational monitoring record. Some peak loads were estimated from population, and modelled least-cost configurations do not establish implemented systems or realized profitability. A reviewer-assessed use is reproducing or challenging off-grid investment assumptions in energy-system simulations. model-pypsa is a related optimization environment, but the source ISLA model was not obtained or run. Round 1’s rejection of a study-specific dataset does not negate this documented reuse value.
